blocks.zh: 建築佈局 — 輔助區域與概念圖（下）
blocks.en: Architectural Layout: Support Areas and Concept Diagrams (Part 2)

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand the design principles for support areas (gowning rooms, equipment prep, parts washing, buffer preparation, component staging) and their role in maintaining cleanroom integrity / 了解輔助區域的設計原則及其對潔淨室完整性的重要性
blocks.en: Understand the design principles for support areas (gowning rooms, equipment prep, parts washing, buffer preparation, component staging) and their role in maintaining cleanroom integrity

blocks.zh: Explain why technical support areas should remain separate and unclassified, and how service chases minimize contamination risk / 說明為何技術輔助區域應保持分離與非分級，以及服務通道如何降低污染風險
blocks.en: Explain why technical support areas should remain separate and unclassified, and how service chases minimize contamination risk

blocks.zh: Interpret five concept diagrams (Figures 4.4–4.8) showing functional adjacencies for different manufacturing configurations: small/large scale, RABS/isolator, aseptic/terminally sterilized / 解讀五種不同製造配置的概念圖
blocks.en: Interpret five concept diagrams (Figures 4.4–4.8) showing functional adjacencies for different manufacturing configurations: small/large scale, RABS/isolator, aseptic/terminally sterilized

blocks.zh: Apply the unidirectional flow principle to material and personnel movement in facility layout / 將單向流動原則應用於物料與人員動線設計
blocks.en: Apply the unidirectional flow principle to material and personnel movement in facility layout

blocks.zh: Differentiate between segregation by physical barrier, procedural control, and time separation / 區分物理屏障隔離、程序控制隔離與時間隔離三種方式
blocks.en: Differentiate between segregation by physical barrier, procedural control, and time separation

blocks.zh: 4.7 Support Areas 4.7 支援區域
blocks.en: 4.7 Support Areas

blocks.zh: 導師解析
blocks.en: Trainer's Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：輔助區域的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Role of Support Areas

blocks.zh: 輔助區域是潔淨室的「後勤供應鏈」。ISPE 將其分為兩類：
blocks.en: Support areas are the "logistics supply chain" of the cleanroom. ISPE divides them into two categories:

blocks.zh: 技術輔助區域（Technical Support）：機電維修、設備後端服務，應保持非分級（Unclassified）並與潔淨室分離
blocks.en: Technical Support areas: electrical/mechanical maintenance and equipment back-end services; these should remain unclassified and separate from the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 製程輔助區域（Process Support）：緩衝液配製、零件清洗、組件暫存等，可與無菌區相鄰但須隔離
blocks.en: Process Support areas: buffer preparation, parts washing, component staging, etc.; these may be adjacent to the aseptic area but must be segregated from it

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：靠近但隔離——縮短管路與搬運距離，同時防止污染回流。
blocks.en: Key principle: close but separate. Keep piping and transport distances short while preventing contamination from flowing back.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：醫院手術室的配套空間
blocks.en: Analogy: The Support Spaces Around an Operating Room

blocks.zh: 想像一間醫院手術室：手術房本身是最高等級潔淨區域，但它周圍還需要：器械消毒間（零件清洗）、藥品準備區（緩衝液配製）、更衣區（更衣室）、以及設備維修通道。
blocks.en: Picture a hospital operating room. The room itself is the highest-grade clean area, but it needs support spaces around it: an instrument sterilization room (parts washing), a drug preparation area (buffer preparation), a changing area (gowning rooms), and a maintenance access route for equipment.

blocks.zh: 這些空間都不需要與手術房同等級的空氣品質，但必須緊鄰手術房以便快速支援，同時隔離以防止外界污染進入。藥廠的輔助區域邏輯完全一樣。
blocks.en: None of these spaces needs the same air quality as the operating room, but they must be adjacent to it for quick support, and at the same time segregated so that outside contamination cannot get in. The logic for pharmaceutical support areas is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：雙面設備的壓差策略
blocks.en: Key Point: Pressure Strategy for Double-Sided Equipment

blocks.zh: 滅菌鍋（Autoclave）、隧道烘箱（Tunnel）、清洗機（Washer）這類橫跨兩個區域的設備，其維修側必須遵守兩條規則：
blocks.en: For equipment that spans two areas, such as autoclaves, tunnels (depyrogenation tunnels), and washers, the maintenance side must follow two rules:

blocks.zh: 從較低等級側進入——避免維修人員穿越高等級區域
blocks.en: Access from the lower-grade side, so that maintenance personnel do not need to pass through higher-grade areas

blocks.zh: 維修側壓差為負壓——確保氣流方向是「從潔淨到非潔淨」，微粒不會從維修通道回流到生產區
blocks.en: Keep the maintenance side at negative pressure, so that air flows "from clean to less clean" and particles cannot flow back from the maintenance corridor into the production area

blocks.zh: 這是 Annex 1 壓差階梯（Pressure Cascade）原則在設備層級的直接應用。
blocks.en: This is a direct application of the Annex 1 pressure cascade principle at the equipment level.

blocks.zh: 可行走天花板（Walkable Ceiling）
blocks.en: Walkable Ceiling

blocks.zh: 可行走天花板讓維修人員從上方進入潔淨室的 HEPA 過濾器、燈具和感測器，而不必進入潔淨室本身。
blocks.en: A walkable ceiling lets maintenance personnel reach the HEPA filters, light fittings, and sensors of the cleanroom from above, without entering the cleanroom itself.

blocks.zh: 限制條件：生產期間禁止進入——行走產生的振動可能使微粒穿透天花板密封件落入潔淨室。這就是為何許多公司將天花板維修排在批次之間或停機期間進行。
blocks.en: Restriction: no access during production. Vibration from walking could cause particles to penetrate the ceiling seals and fall into the cleanroom. This is why many companies schedule ceiling maintenance between batches or during shutdowns.

blocks.zh: 4.7 Support Areas — Design Summary Table 4.7 支援區域 — 設計摘要表
blocks.en: 4.7 Support Areas — Design Summary Table

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：餐廳的前場與後場
blocks.en: Analogy: Front of House and Back of House in a Restaurant

blocks.zh: 任何高檔餐廳都有嚴格的前場（用餐區）與後場（廚房、洗碗間、儲藏室）分區。後場要離前場近（上菜速度），但絕對不能讓油煙、噪音或髒碗回流到用餐區。
blocks.en: Every high-end restaurant has a strict separation between the front of house (dining area) and the back of house (kitchen, dishwashing room, storage). The back of house must be close to the front for fast service, but cooking fumes, noise, and dirty dishes must never flow back into the dining area.

blocks.zh: 藥廠的輔助區域就是潔淨室的「後場」：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical support areas are the "back of house" of the cleanroom:

blocks.zh: 零件清洗區 = 洗碗間
blocks.en: Parts washing area = dishwashing room

blocks.zh: 緩衝液配製 = 備料區
blocks.en: Buffer preparation = food prep area

blocks.zh: 服務通道 = 員工動線
blocks.en: Service chase = staff circulation route

blocks.zh: 可行走天花板 = 屋頂維修通道
blocks.en: Walkable ceiling = rooftop maintenance access

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Review Questions

blocks.zh: 實務應用：輔助區域佈局查核清單
blocks.en: Practical Application: Support Area Layout Checklist

blocks.zh: 所有雙面設備（滅菌鍋、清洗機）維修側是否保持負壓？
blocks.en: Is the maintenance side of all double-sided equipment (autoclaves, washers) kept at negative pressure?

blocks.zh: 服務通道（Service Chase）是否可從生產區外部進入？
blocks.en: Can the service chase be accessed from outside the production area?

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 系統是否可從非分級區域進行維修？
blocks.en: Can CIP/SIP systems be maintained from an unclassified area?

blocks.zh: 潔淨室天花板上方維修是否排除在生產時間之外？
blocks.en: Is maintenance above the cleanroom ceiling excluded from production time?

blocks.zh: 製程輔助區域是否使用視窗（Vision Panel）和傳遞窗（Transfer Hatch）與無菌區通訊？
blocks.en: Do process support areas communicate with the aseptic area through vision panels and transfer hatches?

blocks.zh: 4.8 Concept Diagrams — Overview 4.8 概念圖 — 概述
blocks.en: 4.8 Concept Diagrams — Overview

blocks.zh: 核心概念：概念圖 vs. 平面圖
blocks.en: Core Concept: Concept Diagrams vs. Floor Plans

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調這些是功能鄰接關係圖，不是實際平面圖。它們回答的問題是「哪些房間應該彼此相鄰？」而不是「房間尺寸是多少？」
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that these are functional adjacency diagrams, not actual floor plans. They answer the question "which rooms should be next to each other?" rather than "how big are the rooms?"

blocks.zh: 這種方法的價值在於：先確定功能邏輯（物料流、人員流、隔離需求），再進入具體的建築設計。許多設施設計失敗的根源就是跳過功能鄰接分析，直接畫平面圖。
blocks.en: The value of this approach is that the functional logic (material flow, personnel flow, segregation needs) is settled first, before detailed architectural design begins. Many facility design failures originate from skipping the functional adjacency analysis and drawing floor plans straight away.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：五張圖的分類邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: How the Five Diagrams Are Classified

blocks.zh: ISPE 用兩個維度將無菌製造設施分成五種典型配置：
blocks.en: ISPE uses two dimensions to divide aseptic manufacturing facilities into five typical configurations:

blocks.zh: 理解這三個維度，就能快速判斷你的設施最接近哪個概念圖，再依此為基礎進行細部設計。
blocks.en: Once you understand these dimensions, you can quickly identify which concept diagram is closest to your facility and use it as the basis for detailed design.

blocks.zh: Figure 4.4: Small Scale Open System Aseptic Fill with RABS Figure 4.4: 小規模開放式無菌充填搭配 RABS
blocks.en: Figure 4.4: Small Scale Open System Aseptic Fill with RABS

blocks.zh: 小規模 RABS 設施的關鍵特徵
blocks.en: Key Features of a Small-Scale RABS Facility

blocks.zh: 這是最基礎的無菌充填配置，適合小型 CDMO 或臨床試驗生產。核心特徵：
blocks.en: This is the most basic aseptic filling configuration, suited to small CDMOs or clinical trial manufacture. Core features:

blocks.zh: 全開放製程——產品在非封閉環境下暴露，因此環境控制至關重要
blocks.en: Fully open process: the product is exposed in a non-closed environment, so environmental control is critical

blocks.zh: 非無菌配製——配製室不需無菌等級，但需要隔離以防止交叉污染
blocks.en: Non-sterile preparation: the preparation room does not need a sterile grade, but it must be segregated to prevent cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 無菌過濾作為關鍵控制點——產品在進入充填區前經過除菌過濾
blocks.en: Sterile filtration as a critical control point: the product passes through sterilizing filtration before entering the filling area

blocks.zh: RTP 密閉容器轉運——組件通過密封容器進入 RABS
blocks.en: RTP closed-container transfer: components enter the RABS in sealed containers

blocks.zh: 重點提示：時間隔離（Time Separation）
blocks.en: Key Point: Time Separation

blocks.zh: 當物理隔離不可行（例如廢棄物必須通過製程走廊），ISPE 允許「時間隔離」——在非生產時段（off hours）搬運開放性廢棄物。這並非理想方案，但在空間受限的小型設施中是實用的折衷。
blocks.en: Where physical segregation is not feasible (for example, waste must pass through the process corridor), ISPE allows "time separation": open waste is moved during non-production periods (off hours). This is not an ideal solution, but it is a practical compromise in small facilities with limited space.

blocks.zh: 如果廢棄物污染了走廊，則必須在恢復生產前完成清潔。這意味著需要經過驗證的清潔程序和放行標準。
blocks.en: If waste contaminates the corridor, cleaning must be completed before production resumes. This means validated cleaning procedures and release criteria are needed.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：共用走廊的管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Managing a Shared Corridor

blocks.zh: Process Corridor 就像醫院的公共走廊——醫護人員、訪客、推車都使用同一條路。但手術器械會放在密封推車裡運送，醫療廢棄物則在特定時段由專人清運。
blocks.en: The process corridor is like a public corridor in a hospital: medical staff, visitors, and carts all use the same route. But surgical instruments are transported in sealed carts, and medical waste is removed by designated staff at set times.

blocks.zh: 藥廠的 Process Corridor 採用相同邏輯：非暴露品共用，暴露品密封運送，廢棄物時間隔離。
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical process corridor follows the same logic: non-exposed items share it, exposed items are transported sealed, and waste is separated by time.

blocks.zh: Figure 4.5: Small Scale Open System Aseptic Fill with Isolators Figure 4.5: 小規模開放式無菌充填搭配隔離器
blocks.en: Figure 4.5: Small Scale Open System Aseptic Fill with Isolators

blocks.zh: 重點提示：製程走廊消除了多級氣閘
blocks.en: Key Point: The Process Corridor Eliminates Multiple Airlocks

blocks.zh: ISPE 指出，Process Corridor 的一個重要好處是取代串聯式氣閘（in-line airlocks）。傳統設計中，人員從更衣區到生產區可能需要通過三到四個氣閘，每個都有壓差控制和程序要求。
blocks.en: ISPE notes that an important benefit of the process corridor is that it replaces in-line airlocks. In a traditional design, personnel may have to pass through three or four airlocks between the gowning area and the production area, each with its own pressure differential control and procedural requirements.

blocks.zh: 一條設計良好的 Process Corridor 能讓人員在「逐漸增加潔淨度」的空間中自然過渡，既簡化程序又降低人為錯誤風險。
blocks.en: A well-designed process corridor lets personnel transition naturally through spaces of progressively increasing cleanliness, which simplifies procedures and reduces the risk of human error.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：campaign 生產的限制
blocks.en: Analogy: The Limitation of Campaign Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 「配製室直接連接充填套間」的設計，就像餐廳只有一個備料區。如果今天備料做牛排，就不能同時備料做海鮮——否則交叉污染。你必須「一個產品做完、清潔完、再做下一個」，這就是 Campaign 生產。
blocks.en: A design in which "the preparation room connects directly to the filling suite" is like a restaurant with only one prep area. If you prepare steak today, you cannot prepare seafood at the same time, or you get cross-contamination. You must finish one product, clean, and only then start the next. That is campaign manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 隔離器配置 vs. RABS 配置的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Differences Between the Isolator and RABS Configurations

blocks.zh: 比較 Figure 4.4（RABS）和 Figure 4.5（Isolator）：
blocks.en: Comparing Figure 4.4 (RABS) with Figure 4.5 (isolator):

blocks.zh: 隔離器提供更高的產品保護，但犧牲了操作靈活性。
blocks.en: Isolators provide higher product protection but sacrifice operational flexibility.

blocks.zh: Figure 4.6: Large Scale Open System Aseptic Fill with RABS Figure 4.6: 大規模開放式無菌充填搭配 RABS
blocks.en: Figure 4.6: Large Scale Open System Aseptic Fill with RABS

blocks.zh: 大規模 RABS 的升級設計
blocks.en: Upgraded Design for Large-Scale RABS

blocks.zh: 從 Figure 4.4（小規模）升級到 Figure 4.6（大規模），ISPE 增加了幾項關鍵設計：
blocks.en: In moving from Figure 4.4 (small scale) to Figure 4.6 (large scale), ISPE adds several key design features:

blocks.zh: 單向流動（Unidirectional Flow）——所有產品暴露區域的物料和人員流動方向一致，不允許回流
blocks.en: Unidirectional flow: in all product exposure areas, materials and personnel move in one consistent direction, with no backtracking

blocks.zh: 無菌連接器（Aseptic Connectors）——取代開放式管路連接，減少暴露風險
blocks.en: Aseptic connectors: replace open piping connections to reduce exposure risk

blocks.zh: 自動化冷凍乾燥裝載——消除人工搬運半加塞小瓶的風險
blocks.en: Automated freeze dryer loading: eliminates the risk of manually handling partially stoppered vials

blocks.zh: VHP 傳遞艙——處理無法高壓滅菌的物品
blocks.en: VHP pass-through: handles items that cannot be autoclaved

blocks.zh: 重點提示：為何大規模設施必須單向流動？
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Must Large-Scale Facilities Use Unidirectional Flow?

blocks.zh: 小規模設施可以用 Process Corridor 共用路徑，因為人流物流量小，可透過程序控制管理。但大規模設施的交通量高，共用雙向路徑的交叉污染風險急劇增加。
blocks.en: Small facilities can share a path through a process corridor because traffic of people and materials is low and can be managed through procedural controls. In large facilities, traffic is high, and the cross-contamination risk of shared two-way paths rises sharply.

blocks.zh: 因此 ISPE 在大規模配置中明確要求單向流動：乾淨物料只往高等級方向走，髒污物料只往低等級方向走。這就是「物料流」和「人員流」分離的具體實踐。
blocks.en: For this reason, ISPE explicitly requires unidirectional flow in large-scale configurations: clean materials move only toward higher grades, and soiled materials move only toward lower grades. This is the concrete practice of separating "material flow" and "personnel flow".

blocks.zh: Figure 4.7: Large Scale Open System Aseptic Fill with Isolators Figure 4.7: 大規模開放式無菌充填搭配隔離器
blocks.en: Figure 4.7: Large Scale Open System Aseptic Fill with Isolators

blocks.zh: 隔離器 + 大規模：最高保護等級
blocks.en: Isolators + Large Scale: The Highest Level of Protection

blocks.zh: Figure 4.7 代表了無菌充填的最高保護配置。關鍵特徵：
blocks.en: Figure 4.7 represents the highest-protection configuration for aseptic filling. Key features:

blocks.zh: 幾乎全封閉製程——只有零件清洗是開放製程
blocks.en: Almost fully closed process: only parts washing is an open process

blocks.zh: 隔離器正壓保護——即使加蓋產生微粒，隔離器內的正壓和出口氣流（mousehole）防止微粒回流
blocks.en: Isolator positive pressure protection: even though capping generates particles, the positive pressure inside the isolator and the outflow of air at the opening (mousehole) prevent particles from flowing back

blocks.zh: 加蓋在 ISO 8/Grade C 環境中的 RABS 內進行——因為此時小瓶已完全加塞，瓶蓋不需無菌
blocks.en: Capping is performed inside a RABS in an ISO 8/Grade C environment, because at this point the vials are fully stoppered and the caps do not need to be sterile

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Mousehole 的概念
blocks.en: Analogy: The Mousehole Concept

blocks.zh: Mousehole（鼠洞）是隔離器與外部環境之間的小開口，讓產品容器通過。想像一棟建築的通風口——總是有氣流向外吹出，所以灰塵不會從外面吹進來。
blocks.en: A mousehole is a small opening between the isolator and the outside environment that lets product containers pass through. Think of a ventilation opening in a building: air is always blowing outward, so dust cannot blow in from outside.

blocks.zh: 隔離器的 mousehole 利用同樣原理：隔離器內部正壓使空氣持續從 mousehole 向外流出，阻止加蓋區的微粒進入無菌充填區域。
blocks.en: The isolator mousehole uses the same principle: positive pressure inside the isolator keeps air flowing out through the mousehole, preventing particles from the capping area from entering the aseptic filling area.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：雙向氣閘（Bidirectional Airlock）
blocks.en: Key Point: Bidirectional Airlock

blocks.zh: Pre-Wash 區的雙向氣閘設計精妙：人員進入時加穿防護衣（over-gown），離開時脫掉。目的是確保接觸過暴露產品的防護衣不會被帶入 Process Corridor，避免殘留產品交叉污染。
blocks.en: The bidirectional airlock in the pre-wash area is cleverly designed: personnel put on an over-gown when entering and remove it when leaving. The aim is to ensure that gowns that have touched exposed product are not carried into the process corridor, avoiding cross-contamination from product residues.

blocks.zh: 這是「人員流」管理中的重要細節——不只是控制人往哪走，還要控制人身上帶了什麼。
blocks.en: This is an important detail of personnel flow management: it is not only about controlling where people go, but also what they carry on them.

blocks.zh: Figure 4.8: Large Scale Open Filling for Terminally Sterilized Product with RABS Figure 4.8: 大規模開放式終端滅菌產品充填搭配 RABS
blocks.en: Figure 4.8: Large Scale Open Filling for Terminally Sterilized Product with RABS

blocks.zh: 重點提示：終端滅菌不代表可以放鬆環境控制
blocks.en: Key Point: Terminal Sterilization Does Not Mean Relaxed Environmental Control

blocks.zh: 雖然終端滅菌提供了額外的安全網，ISPE 仍然要求：
blocks.en: Although terminal sterilization provides an additional safety net, ISPE still requires:

blocks.zh: 充填在 RABS + LP/GAAS 下進行
blocks.en: Filling takes place in a RABS with LP/GAAS

blocks.zh: 開放製程區域需要隔離
blocks.en: Open process areas need segregation

blocks.zh: 更衣流程單向設計
blocks.en: Gowning flow is unidirectional

blocks.zh: 同一時間只能生產一個產品
blocks.en: Only one product at a time is manufactured

blocks.zh: 這反映了現代法規趨勢：即使是終端滅菌產品，也應盡可能降低充填前的微生物負荷（bioburden），以確保滅菌保證水準（SAL）。
blocks.en: This reflects the modern regulatory trend: even for terminally sterilized products, pre-fill bioburden should be minimized as far as possible to ensure the sterility assurance level (SAL).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：更衣流程的單向設計
blocks.en: Analogy: One-Way Gowning Flow

blocks.zh: 想像游泳池的更衣室：進入泳池前走淋浴通道（穿上泳衣、淋浴），離開泳池後走另一條出口（沖洗、換回便服）。如果進出走同一條路，濕淋淋的泳客會弄髒準備進場的乾淨區域。
blocks.en: Think of a swimming pool changing facility: before entering the pool you go through the shower route (put on swimwear, shower), and after leaving the pool you use a separate exit (rinse, change back into street clothes). If entry and exit used the same path, dripping swimmers would dirty the clean area for those about to enter.

blocks.zh: 藥廠更衣室的單向設計原理完全一樣——進入的人不會與離開的人在更衣區交會，確保潔淨更衣用品不被污染。
blocks.en: The one-way design of pharmaceutical gowning rooms works on exactly the same principle: people entering do not cross paths with people leaving in the gowning area, so clean gowning supplies are not contaminated.

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌 vs. 無菌充填：設施設計的根本差異
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization vs. Aseptic Filling: The Fundamental Difference in Facility Design

blocks.zh: Figure 4.8 是唯一的終端滅菌（Terminally Sterilized）配置，與前四張圖的無菌充填有本質差異：
blocks.en: Figure 4.8 is the only terminally sterilized configuration, and it differs in essence from the aseptic filling of the previous four diagrams:

blocks.zh: Cross-Diagram Comparison — Five Configurations at a Glance 跨圖比較 — 五種配置一覽
blocks.en: Cross-Diagram Comparison — Five Configurations at a Glance

blocks.zh: 五張圖的共通設計原則
blocks.en: Design Principles Common to All Five Diagrams

blocks.zh: 無論選擇哪種配置，ISPE 強調的核心設計原則始終不變：
blocks.en: Whichever configuration is chosen, the core design principles ISPE emphasizes remain the same:

blocks.zh: 隔離開放製程——任何產品暴露的房間都需要獨立隔離
blocks.en: Segregate open processes: any room where product is exposed needs separate segregation

blocks.zh: 密封轉運——所有組件在潔淨區間的移動都必須在密閉容器中進行
blocks.en: Sealed transfer: all component movement between clean areas must take place in closed containers

blocks.zh: 更衣分流——進入與離開的更衣路徑分開，避免污染潔淨更衣用品
blocks.en: Separate gowning flows: entry and exit gowning paths are separate, to avoid contaminating clean gowning supplies

blocks.zh: 廢棄物管理——密封或時間隔離，二擇一
blocks.en: Waste management: sealed or time-separated, one or the other

blocks.zh: Process Corridor 共用——但僅限非暴露品與人員
blocks.en: Shared process corridor: but only for non-exposed items and personnel

blocks.en: Practical Application: Choose Your Facility Configuration

blocks.zh: 你正在規劃一座新的無菌充填設施。請根據以下場景，判斷最適合的概念圖：
blocks.en: You are planning a new aseptic filling facility. Based on the following scenarios, decide which concept diagram fits best:

blocks.en: Annual output of 5 million vials of injectables; the product is heat-stable and can withstand terminal sterilization → ?

blocks.en: Annual output of 100,000 vials of a biologic; heat-labile, requires aseptic filling, limited budget → ?

blocks.zh: 年產量 2,000 萬瓶大輸液，需冷凍乾燥，要求最高產品保護等級 → ?
blocks.en: Annual output of 20 million vials of large-volume parenterals, requiring freeze drying and the highest level of product protection → ?

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重點回顧
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 4.7 輔助區域 — 核心要點
blocks.en: 4.7 Support Areas — Key Points

blocks.zh: 技術輔助區域（機電維修）應靠近潔淨室但保持非分級與物理分離
blocks.en: Technical support areas (electrical/mechanical maintenance) should be close to the cleanroom but remain unclassified and physically separate

blocks.zh: 製程輔助區域（配製、零件清洗、緩衝液配製）必須與無菌區隔離
blocks.en: Process support areas (preparation, parts washing, buffer preparation) must be segregated from the aseptic area

blocks.zh: 雙面設備從較低等級側維修，維修側保持負壓
blocks.en: Double-sided equipment is maintained from the lower-grade side, and the maintenance side is kept at negative pressure

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 系統宜設於生產區上方或下方，可從非分級區域維修
blocks.en: CIP/SIP systems are best located above or below the production area, so they can be maintained from an unclassified area

blocks.zh: 可行走天花板在生產期間禁止進入
blocks.en: No access to the walkable ceiling during production

blocks.zh: 4.8 概念圖 — 核心要點
blocks.en: 4.8 Concept Diagrams — Key Points

blocks.zh: 五張概念圖涵蓋小/大規模 + RABS/隔離器 + 無菌充填/終端滅菌的典型配置
blocks.en: The five concept diagrams cover typical configurations across small/large scale, RABS/isolator, and aseptic filling/terminal sterilization

blocks.zh: 所有配置共享：開放製程隔離、密閉轉運、單向更衣、廢棄物密封或時間隔離
blocks.en: All configurations share: segregation of open processes, closed transfer, unidirectional gowning, and sealed or time-separated waste

blocks.zh: 隔離器因屏障完整性高，允許較低的背景環境等級
blocks.en: Because of their high barrier integrity, isolators allow a lower background environment grade

blocks.zh: 大規模設施必須實施單向流動
blocks.en: Large-scale facilities must implement unidirectional flow

blocks.zh: Process Corridor 概念簡化了傳統多級氣閘設計
blocks.en: The process corridor concept simplifies the traditional multiple-airlock design
